description: This file provides utility functions for handling media MIME types, including mapping MIME types to file extensions, detecting MIME types from buffers or file paths, normalizing MIME types, and identifying media formats such as GIF or image types. It also exports functions for external use related to MIME type processing.

methods.name: normalizeMimeType
methods.description: Normalizes a MIME type string by trimming, lowercasing, and removing parameters.

methods.name: detectMime
methods.description: Detects the MIME type of a buffer or file based on content, header, or extension.

methods.name: getFileExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a URL or file path.

methods.name: isAudioFileName
methods.description: Checks if a filename has an extension associated with audio files.

methods.name: extensionForMime
methods.description: Returns the preferred file extension for a given MIME type.

methods.name: isGifMedia
methods.description: Determines if media content is a GIF based on content type or file extension.

methods.name: imageMimeFromFormat
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given image format string.

methods.name: kindFromMime
methods.description: Maps a MIME type to a MediaKind enumeration value.
